<style id="ultimate-ada-translator-inline-css">
.ultimate-ada-translator {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	direction: ltr;
	display: inline-flex;
	position: relative;
	vertical-align: middle;
}

html.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl {
	direction: rtl;
}

/* Preserve the selected direction when original content hard-codes it. */
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content * {
	direction: ltr !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align: right"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align:right"] {
	text-align: left !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content * {
	direction: rtl !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align: left"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align:left"] {
	text-align: right !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator *,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::before,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator .notranslate {
	translate: no;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #fff;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2.25rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;
	width: 2.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__close:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__tab:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__search:focus,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid #99cfff;
	outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__icon {
	display: block;
	height: 1.5625rem;
	transform: none;
	width: 1.5625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	background: #1f2933;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #fff;
	font-size: 0.75rem;
	left: 50%;
	line-height: 1.2;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: absolute;
	top: calc(100% + 0.45rem);
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	white-space: nowrap;
	z-index: 4;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip,
.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop {
	background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.48);
	border: 0;
	cursor: default;
	inset: 0;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	z-index: 999990;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	background: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 8px;
	box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.32);
	color: #17202a;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.875rem;
	left: 50%;
	max-height: min(34rem, calc(100vh - 3rem));
	max-width: min(92vw, 28rem);
	min-width: min(92vw, 20rem);
	opacity: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	padding: 1rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	top: 50%;
	transform: translate(-50%, -48%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	width: 28rem;
	z-index: 1000000;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	opacity: 1;
	pointer-events: auto;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel-header {
	align-items: flex-start;
	display: flex;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tabs {
	align-items: stretch;
	background: #eef2f7;
	border-radius: 6px;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	gap: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab {
	appearance: none;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 0;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	margin: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem;
	text-align: center;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab.is-active {
	background: #fff;
	color: #0f172a;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel[hidden] {
	display: none !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel {
	display: flex;
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	min-height: 0;
	overflow-y: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__title {
	color: #0f172a;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__copy,
.ultimate-ada-translator__status,
.ultimate-ada-translator__empty {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.4;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	margin: -0.375rem -0.375rem 0 0;
	padding: 0;
	width: 2rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close:hover {
	background: #e2e8f0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close svg {
	display: block;
	height: 1.125rem;
	width: 1.125rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__field {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-copy {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.45;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__label {
	color: inherit;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__search,
.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	appearance: none;
	background-color: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #1f2933;
	font: inherit;
	line-height: 1.4;
	min-height: 2.35rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	display: none;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset {
	background-color: transparent;
	border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	min-height: 2.125rem;
	padding: 0.45rem 0.625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:hover {
	background-color: #005ea8;
	border-color: #005ea8;
	color: #fff;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-options {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.5rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	justify-content: flex-start;
	line-height: 1.3;
	min-height: 2.5rem;
	padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
	text-align: left;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__list {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
	max-height: min(16rem, calc(100vh - 18rem));
	overflow: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	gap: 0.5rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
	line-height: 1.25;
	min-height: 2.25rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	text-align: left;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-code {
	color: #64748b;
	font-size: 0.6875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	min-width: 0;
	width: auto;
}

#primary-nav .ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	margin-top: -10px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator-menu-item {
	position: relative;
}

#ultimate_ada_translate_element,
.skiptranslate iframe,
iframe.goog-te-banner-frame,
.goog-te-banner-frame,
.VIpgJd-ZVi9od-ORHb-OEVmcd {
	display: none !important;
	visibility: hidden !important;
}

body {
	top: 0 !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-lightbox-open {
	overflow: hidden;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast * {
	background-color: #000 !important;
	border-color: #fff !important;
	color: #fff !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast a {
	color: #ff0 !important;
	text-decoration: underline !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast img {
	filter: grayscale(100%);
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-links a {
	background: #ff0 !important;
	color: #111827 !important;
	padding: 0 2px;
	text-decoration: underline !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia button,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia input,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia select,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia textarea,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia p,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia li,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia span,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia a,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h1,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h2,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h3,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h4,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h5,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h6 {
	font-family: Arial, Verdana, Helvetica, sans-serif !important;
	letter-spacing: 0.03em !important;
	word-spacing: 0.08em !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-motion *,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-motion *::before,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-motion *::after {
	animation: none !important;
	scroll-behavior: auto !important;
	transition: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
	.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
		border-radius: 8px;
		max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem);
		min-width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
		width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
	}

	.ultimate-ada-translator__list {
		max-height: calc(100vh - 19rem);
	}

	.ultimate-ada-translator__tab {
		font-size: 0.75rem;
		padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem;
	}
}

<style id="ultimate-ada-translator-inline-css">
.ultimate-ada-translator {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	direction: ltr;
	display: inline-flex;
	position: relative;
	vertical-align: middle;
}

html.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl {
	direction: rtl;
}

/* Preserve the selected direction when original content hard-codes it. */
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content * {
	direction: ltr !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align: right"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align:right"] {
	text-align: left !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content * {
	direction: rtl !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align: left"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align:left"] {
	text-align: right !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator *,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::before,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator .notranslate {
	translate: no;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #fff;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2.25rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;
	width: 2.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__close:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__tab:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__search:focus,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid #99cfff;
	outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__icon {
	display: block;
	height: 1.5625rem;
	transform: none;
	width: 1.5625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	background: #1f2933;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #fff;
	font-size: 0.75rem;
	left: 50%;
	line-height: 1.2;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: absolute;
	top: calc(100% + 0.45rem);
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	white-space: nowrap;
	z-index: 4;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip,
.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop {
	background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.48);
	border: 0;
	cursor: default;
	inset: 0;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	z-index: 999990;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	background: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 8px;
	box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.32);
	color: #17202a;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.875rem;
	left: 50%;
	max-height: min(34rem, calc(100vh - 3rem));
	max-width: min(92vw, 28rem);
	min-width: min(92vw, 20rem);
	opacity: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	padding: 1rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	top: 50%;
	transform: translate(-50%, -48%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	width: 28rem;
	z-index: 1000000;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	opacity: 1;
	pointer-events: auto;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel-header {
	align-items: flex-start;
	display: flex;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tabs {
	align-items: stretch;
	background: #eef2f7;
	border-radius: 6px;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	gap: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab {
	appearance: none;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 0;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	margin: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem;
	text-align: center;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab.is-active {
	background: #fff;
	color: #0f172a;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel[hidden] {
	display: none !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel {
	display: flex;
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	min-height: 0;
	overflow-y: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__title {
	color: #0f172a;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__copy,
.ultimate-ada-translator__status,
.ultimate-ada-translator__empty {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.4;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	margin: -0.375rem -0.375rem 0 0;
	padding: 0;
	width: 2rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close:hover {
	background: #e2e8f0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close svg {
	display: block;
	height: 1.125rem;
	width: 1.125rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__field {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-copy {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.45;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__label {
	color: inherit;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__search,
.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	appearance: none;
	background-color: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #1f2933;
	font: inherit;
	line-height: 1.4;
	min-height: 2.35rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	display: none;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset {
	background-color: transparent;
	border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	min-height: 2.125rem;
	padding: 0.45rem 0.625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:hover {
	background-color: #005ea8;
	border-color: #005ea8;
	color: #fff;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-options {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.5rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	justify-content: flex-start;
	line-height: 1.3;
	min-height: 2.5rem;
	padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
	text-align: left;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__list {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
	max-height: min(16rem, calc(100vh - 18rem));
	overflow: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	gap: 0.5rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
	line-height: 1.25;
	min-height: 2.25rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	text-align: left;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-code {
	color: #64748b;
	font-size: 0.6875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	min-width: 0;
	width: auto;
}

#primary-nav .ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	margin-top: -10px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator-menu-item {
	position: relative;
}

#ultimate_ada_translate_element,
.skiptranslate iframe,
iframe.goog-te-banner-frame,
.goog-te-banner-frame,
.VIpgJd-ZVi9od-ORHb-OEVmcd {
	display: none !important;
	visibility: hidden !important;
}

body {
	top: 0 !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-lightbox-open {

	function getCookieDomains(hostname) {

	}

<style id="ultimate-ada-translator-inline-css">
.ultimate-ada-translator {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	direction: ltr;
	display: inline-flex;
	position: relative;
	vertical-align: middle;
}

html.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl {
	direction: rtl;
}

/* Preserve the selected direction when original content hard-codes it. */
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content * {
	direction: ltr !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align: right"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align:right"] {
	text-align: left !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content * {
	direction: rtl !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align: left"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align:left"] {
	text-align: right !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator *,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::before,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator .notranslate {
	translate: no;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #fff;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2.25rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;
	width: 2.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__close:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__tab:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__search:focus,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid #99cfff;
	outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__icon {
	display: block;
	height: 1.5625rem;
	transform: none;
	width: 1.5625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	background: #1f2933;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #fff;
	font-size: 0.75rem;
	left: 50%;
	line-height: 1.2;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: absolute;
	top: calc(100% + 0.45rem);
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	white-space: nowrap;
	z-index: 4;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip,
.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop {
	background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.48);
	border: 0;
	cursor: default;
	inset: 0;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	z-index: 999990;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	background: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 8px;
	box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.32);
	color: #17202a;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.875rem;
	left: 50%;
	max-height: min(34rem, calc(100vh - 3rem));
	max-width: min(92vw, 28rem);
	min-width: min(92vw, 20rem);
	opacity: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	padding: 1rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	top: 50%;
	transform: translate(-50%, -48%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	width: 28rem;
	z-index: 1000000;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	opacity: 1;
	pointer-events: auto;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel-header {
	align-items: flex-start;
	display: flex;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tabs {
	align-items: stretch;
	background: #eef2f7;
	border-radius: 6px;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	gap: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab {
	appearance: none;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 0;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	margin: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem;
	text-align: center;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab.is-active {
	background: #fff;
	color: #0f172a;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel[hidden] {
	display: none !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel {
	display: flex;
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	min-height: 0;
	overflow-y: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;

.ultimate-ada-translator__title {
	color: #0f172a;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__copy,
.ultimate-ada-translator__status,
.ultimate-ada-translator__empty {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.4;
	margin: 0;

.ultimate-ada-translator__close {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;

	box-sizing: border-box;
	direction: ltr;
	display: inline-flex;
	position: relative;
	vertical-align: middle;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl {
	direction: rtl;
}

	direction: ltr !important;
}

	direction: rtl !important;
}

	text-align: right !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;

	translate: no;

	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #fff;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2.25rem;
	justify-content: center;

	width: 2.25rem;

	transform: none;

	box-sizing: border-box;
	direction: ltr;
	display: inline-flex;
	position: relative;
	vertical-align: middle;
}

html.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl {
	direction: rtl;
}

/* Preserve the selected direction when original content hard-codes it. */
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content * {
	direction: ltr !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align: right"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align:right"] {
	text-align: left !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content * {
	direction: rtl !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align: left"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align:left"] {
	text-align: right !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator *,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::before,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator .notranslate {
	translate: no;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #fff;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2.25rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;
	width: 2.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__close:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__tab:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__search:focus,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid #99cfff;
	outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__icon {
	display: block;
	height: 1.5625rem;
	transform: none;
	width: 1.5625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	background: #1f2933;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #fff;
	font-size: 0.75rem;
	left: 50%;
	line-height: 1.2;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: absolute;
	top: calc(100% + 0.45rem);
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	white-space: nowrap;
	z-index: 4;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip,
.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop {
	background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.48);
	border: 0;
	cursor: default;
	inset: 0;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	z-index: 999990;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	background: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 8px;
	box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.32);
	color: #17202a;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.875rem;
	left: 50%;
	max-height: min(34rem, calc(100vh - 3rem));
	max-width: min(92vw, 28rem);
	min-width: min(92vw, 20rem);
	opacity: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	padding: 1rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	top: 50%;
	transform: translate(-50%, -48%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	width: 28rem;
	z-index: 1000000;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	opacity: 1;
	pointer-events: auto;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel-header {
	align-items: flex-start;
	display: flex;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tabs {
	align-items: stretch;
	background: #eef2f7;
	border-radius: 6px;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	gap: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab {
	appearance: none;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 0;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	margin: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem;
	text-align: center;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab.is-active {
	background: #fff;
	color: #0f172a;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel[hidden] {
	display: none !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel {
	display: flex;
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	min-height: 0;
	overflow-y: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__title {
	color: #0f172a;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__copy,
.ultimate-ada-translator__status,
.ultimate-ada-translator__empty {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.4;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	margin: -0.375rem -0.375rem 0 0;
	padding: 0;
	width: 2rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close:hover {
	background: #e2e8f0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close svg {
	display: block;
	height: 1.125rem;
	width: 1.125rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__field {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-copy {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.45;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__label {
	color: inherit;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__search,
.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	appearance: none;
	background-color: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #1f2933;
	font: inherit;
	line-height: 1.4;
	min-height: 2.35rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	display: none;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset {
	background-color: transparent;
	border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	min-height: 2.125rem;
	padding: 0.45rem 0.625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:hover {
	background-color: #005ea8;
	border-color: #005ea8;
	color: #fff;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-options {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.5rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	justify-content: flex-start;
	line-height: 1.3;
	min-height: 2.5rem;
	padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
	text-align: left;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__list {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
	max-height: min(16rem, calc(100vh - 18rem));
	overflow: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	gap: 0.5rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
	line-height: 1.25;
	min-height: 2.25rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	text-align: left;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-code {
	color: #64748b;
	font-size: 0.6875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	min-width: 0;
	width: auto;
}

#primary-nav .ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	margin-top: -10px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator-menu-item {
	position: relative;
}

}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-motion *::after {
	animation: none !important;
	scroll-behavior: auto !important;
	transition: none !important;
}

	.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
		border-radius: 8px;
		max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem);

<style id="ultimate-ada-translator-inline-css">
.ultimate-ada-translator {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	direction: ltr;
	display: inline-flex;
	position: relative;
	vertical-align: middle;
}

html.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl {
	direction: rtl;
}

/* Preserve the selected direction when original content hard-codes it. */
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content * {
	direction: ltr !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align: right"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-ltr .site-content [style*="text-align:right"] {
	text-align: left !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content * {
	direction: rtl !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align: left"],
body.ultimate-ada-translator-rtl .site-content [style*="text-align:left"] {
	text-align: right !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator *,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::before,
.ultimate-ada-translator *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator .notranslate {
	translate: no;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #fff;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2.25rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;
	width: 2.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__trigger {
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__close:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__tab:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__search:focus,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:focus-visible,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid #99cfff;
	outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__icon {
	display: block;
	height: 1.5625rem;
	transform: none;
	width: 1.5625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	background: #1f2933;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #fff;
	font-size: 0.75rem;
	left: 50%;
	line-height: 1.2;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: absolute;
	top: calc(100% + 0.45rem);
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	white-space: nowrap;
	z-index: 4;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:hover .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip,
.ultimate-ada-translator__trigger:focus-visible .ultimate-ada-translator__tooltip {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop {
	background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.48);
	border: 0;
	cursor: default;
	inset: 0;
	opacity: 0;
	padding: 0;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	z-index: 999990;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	background: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 8px;
	box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.32);
	color: #17202a;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.875rem;
	left: 50%;
	max-height: min(34rem, calc(100vh - 3rem));
	max-width: min(92vw, 28rem);
	min-width: min(92vw, 20rem);
	opacity: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	padding: 1rem;
	pointer-events: none;
	position: fixed;
	top: 50%;
	transform: translate(-50%, -48%);
	transition: opacity 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
	visibility: hidden;
	width: 28rem;
	z-index: 1000000;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__backdrop,
.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	opacity: 1;
	pointer-events: auto;
	visibility: visible;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator[data-open="true"] .ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
	transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__panel-header {
	align-items: flex-start;
	display: flex;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tabs {
	align-items: stretch;
	background: #eef2f7;
	border-radius: 6px;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	gap: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab {
	appearance: none;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 0;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	margin: 0;
	min-height: 2.75rem;
	padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem;
	text-align: center;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab.is-active {
	background: #fff;
	color: #0f172a;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel[hidden] {
	display: none !important;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-panel {
	display: flex;
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	min-height: 0;
	overflow-y: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__title {
	color: #0f172a;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__copy,
.ultimate-ada-translator__status,
.ultimate-ada-translator__empty {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.4;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close {
	align-items: center;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 999px;
	color: #334155;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	height: 2rem;
	justify-content: center;
	line-height: 1;
	margin: -0.375rem -0.375rem 0 0;
	padding: 0;
	width: 2rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close:hover {
	background: #e2e8f0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__close svg {
	display: block;
	height: 1.125rem;
	width: 1.125rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__field {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__tab-copy {
	color: #475569;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	line-height: 1.45;
	margin: 0;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__label {
	color: inherit;
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__search,
.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	appearance: none;
	background-color: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #1f2933;
	font: inherit;
	line-height: 1.4;
	min-height: 2.35rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__select {
	display: none;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset {
	background-color: transparent;
	border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	min-height: 2.125rem;
	padding: 0.45rem 0.625rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__reset:hover {
	background-color: #005ea8;
	border-color: #005ea8;
	color: #fff;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-options {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.5rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #d8dee6;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	font-size: 0.8125rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	justify-content: flex-start;
	line-height: 1.3;
	min-height: 2.5rem;
	padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
	text-align: left;
	transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__accessibility-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__list {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.375rem;
	max-height: min(16rem, calc(100vh - 18rem));
	overflow: auto;
	padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button {
	align-items: center;
	background: #f8fafc;
	border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
	border-radius: 4px;
	color: #0f172a;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: flex;
	font: inherit;
	gap: 0.5rem;
	justify-content: space-between;
	line-height: 1.25;
	min-height: 2.25rem;
	padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
	text-align: left;
	width: 100%;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button:hover,
.ultimate-ada-translator__language-button.is-active {
	background: #e0f2fe;
	border-color: #0284c7;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator__language-code {
	color: #64748b;
	font-size: 0.6875rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	min-width: 0;
	width: auto;
}

#primary-nav .ultimate-ada-translator--menu {
	margin-top: -10px;
}

.ultimate-ada-translator-menu-item {
	position: relative;
}

#ultimate_ada_translate_element,
.skiptranslate iframe,
iframe.goog-te-banner-frame,
.goog-te-banner-frame,
.VIpgJd-ZVi9od-ORHb-OEVmcd {
	display: none !important;
	visibility: hidden !important;
}

body {
	top: 0 !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-lightbox-open {
	overflow: hidden;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast * {
	background-color: #000 !important;
	border-color: #fff !important;
	color: #fff !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast a {
	color: #ff0 !important;
	text-decoration: underline !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-contrast img {
	filter: grayscale(100%);
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-links a {
	background: #ff0 !important;
	color: #111827 !important;
	padding: 0 2px;
	text-decoration: underline !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia button,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia input,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia select,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia textarea,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia p,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia li,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia span,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia a,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h1,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h2,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h3,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h4,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h5,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-dyslexia h6 {
	font-family: Arial, Verdana, Helvetica, sans-serif !important;
	letter-spacing: 0.03em !important;
	word-spacing: 0.08em !important;
}

body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-motion *,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-motion *::before,
body.ultimate-ada-translator-access-motion *::after {
	animation: none !important;
	scroll-behavior: auto !important;
	transition: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
	.ultimate-ada-translator__panel {
		border-radius: 8px;
		max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem);
		min-width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
		width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
	}

	.ultimate-ada-translator__list {
		max-height: calc(100vh - 19rem);
	}

	.ultimate-ada-translator__tab {
		font-size: 0.75rem;
		padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem;
	}
}
